name: Lesser Of Two Evils
overview: Scripture reveals the reality of evil as a pervasive force that surrounds and challenges God's people, as seen in the numerous evils that beset them and the consequences of turning away from God (Deuteronomy 31:17-18; Psalms 40:12). Believers are warned against following the crowd into wrongdoing or adopting the ways of oppressors, emphasizing the call to choose righteousness rather than compromise with lesser evils (Exodus 23:2; Proverbs 3:31). The distinction between greater and lesser lights in creation (Genesis 1:16) reminds us that God ordains order and clarity, urging His people to reject the temptation to settle for lesser evils when faced with difficult choices.
